outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle (frames 30–115, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then engages it and pulls outward. The drawer visibly projects from the cabinet with its side exposed by frames 181–200 (image and left_ego_image). It remains open through frame 307, with further outward movement near the end (image, left_ego_image, and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or other side effect is visibly established.
